title: DEPHYRIER Decode (EN ES ZH)
style: typo-decode anthem, 88 bpm, English Spanish Mandarin pinyin trilingual, deadpan parser-tolerance rap, terminal core, human-first decoding chant, DEPHYRIER signature, multilingual fuzzy-match flow
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
DEPHYRIER decoded what the operator types
Through autocorrect and reboot pipes
Udi means UUID hdaover means handover
Whuyi means why is the lane the rover

[Pre-Chorus — Mandarin pinyin]
Mi ma jie ma yi qi duan
DEPHYRIER li jie de xin yuan
(Decode the puzzle together unite / DEPHYRIER understands the heart's wish)

[Chorus — trilingual]
Decode pinyin descifrar the typo
DEPHYRIER reads through the operator's flow
Not a request to be polished or styled
The meaning is clear though the keyboard is wild

[Verse 2 — English]
For cthe stops the rkacks the bath langues
The lane translates without the song's pangs
Flexible parser human first not strict
DEPHYRIER the lane understands the slick

[Bridge — Mandarin pinyin]
Da zi cuo wu wu suo wei
Yi si ming bai jiu ke yi
(Typo errors no big deal / Meaning understood is enough)

[Outro — trilingual]
Decode descifrar pinyin jie ma
DEPHYRIER reads what the keys couldn't draw
